dish.title: Cashew Chicken Stir-Fry
dish.description: Takeout-style cashew chicken at home: cornstarch-velveted chicken breast seared in a hot skillet with red bell pepper, celery, onion, garlic, and ginger, glossed in a savory-sweet soy-hoisin sauce, and tossed with toasted cashews and scallions over jasmine rice.

recipe_version.title: Cashew Chicken Stir-Fry
recipe_version.description: Takeout-style cashew chicken at home: cornstarch-velveted chicken breast seared in a hot skillet with red bell pepper, celery, onion, garlic, and ginger, glossed in a savory-sweet soy-hoisin sauce, and tossed with toasted cashews and scallions over jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: 2 cups for the rice, 1/3 cup for the sauce

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp for the chicken, 3 tbsp for the sauce. Soy and wheat allergens.

ingredients.name: dry sherry
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp for the chicken, 1 tbsp for the sauce

ingredients.name: cornstarch
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp for the chicken, 1 tsp for the sauce

ingredients.name: hoisin sauce
ingredients.note: bottled. Typical hoisin contains soy, wheat, and often sesame.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.display_name: neutral high-heat oil (canola or avocado; not peanut oil)
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp per chicken batch, 1 tbsp for the vegetables

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.preparation: cut into 1-inch lengths, whites and greens separated

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: At the start of prep, put the rinsed rice and 2 cups water in a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. Cover, reduce to low, and cook 15 minutes; turn off the heat and rest, covered, 10 minutes. It needs no further attention and is ready before the stir-fry is done.

steps.title: Velvet the chicken and mix the sauce
steps.body: Cut the chicken into 3/4-inch pieces and toss with 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sherry, and 1 tbsp cornstarch until evenly coated; let it sit while you prep. In a small bowl, whisk the remaining 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp sherry, the hoisin, brown sugar, 1 tsp cornstarch, and 1/3 cup water. Cut the bell pepper, celery, and onion; mince the garlic and ginger; cut the scallions, keeping whites and greens apart.

steps.title: Toast the cashews
steps.body: Toast the cashews in a dry 12-inch skillet over medium heat, tossing often, until golden in spots and fragrant, 3 to 4 minutes. Move them to a plate.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.body: Raise the heat to high. Add 1 tbsp oil and, once shimmering, half the chicken in a single layer. Sear undisturbed until golden underneath, about 2 minutes, then stir-fry until just cooked through with no pink (165 F), about 2 minutes more. Move to a plate. Repeat with 1 tbsp oil and the rest of the chicken.

steps.title: Stir-fry the vegetables
steps.body: Add the last 1 tbsp oil to the hot skillet. Add the onion, celery, bell pepper, and scallion whites and stir-fry until crisp-tender with a few charred spots, about 3 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger and stir 30 seconds, until fragrant.

steps.title: Sauce and finish
steps.body: Return the chicken and its juices. Re-whisk the sauce, pour it in, and toss until it bubbles and turns glossy and lightly thick, about 1 minute. Off the heat, toss in the cashews, scallion greens, and sesame oil. Fluff the rice and serve the stir-fry over it. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 15 (rice goes on at prep minute 0: 2 minutes hands-on, then 15 cook + 10 rest unattended, ready at minute 27, before the stir-fry finishes at 33). Cook 18 = 4 toast cashews + 8 sear chicken in 2 batches + 4 vegetables and aromatics + 2 sauce and finish.
recipe_version.heat: High to boil the rice, then low; medium dry skillet for the cashews; high heat for searing and stir-frying. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Chicken golden in spots and just cooked through (165 F). Vegetables crisp-tender with a few charred spots. Sauce glossy and lightly thick, coating rather than pooling. Cashews golden. kitchen_tested is false.
